svg.title: Describe each category in your own words
svg.desc: The MiniMail categories screen: Invitations, Notifications, Verification codes, Receipts, Newsletters and Ads. The Receipts category is open for editing, showing a plain-language description of the mail that belongs in it: receipts, invoices, order confirmations, tickets and package tracking updates.
svg.text: Calendar invitations and event or meeting responses: someone inviting the recipient to a meeting, call or event; updated…
Automated messages triggered by activity in an app or service: alerts, order and shipping updates, billing or security…
Emails whose main purpose is delivering a one-time code or link so the recipient can sign in, reset a password or verify…
Proof-of-purchase mail, tickets and package tracking updates: receipts, invoices, payment confirmations, order confirmations,
subscription renewals and billing statements, refund confirmations, travel and events tickets and confirmations, updates on
package tracking. They belong here even though they are automated. Do not include marketing about a purchase.
Write it in your own words
Editorial mail whose content is news or reading: a newsletter, digest, blog or press roundup, or articles and updates…
Mail that tries to sell something or promote the sender's own company: promotions, discounts, sales and offers, product…
